schools.name: Active School List Api
schools.description:
API endpoint to list schools with recent activity.

GET /api/schools/
Returns: Top 25 schools by number of active debaters in last 2 years
Cached for 5 minutes.

all-schools.name: All School List Api
all-schools.description:
API endpoint to list all schools.

GET /api/schools/all/
Returns: List of all schools in the database
Cached for 5 minutes.

schedule.name: Schedule Api
schedule.description: Expose the APDA tournament schedule grouped by month/week.

standings.name: Season Standings Api
standings.description:
Return TOTY/COTY/SOTY/NOTY/Online standings in a machine-friendly format.
Requires a season query parameter (defaults to CURRENT_SEASON).

replay.name: Season Standings Replay Api
replay.description: Return TOTY/SOTY/COTY standings along with all season markers for replay visualizations.

through.name: Standings Through Date Api
through.description: Return standings snapshots through a supplied ISO date.

school.name: School Detail Api
school.description: Season-aware school profile with COTY history, hosted tournaments, and roster info.

debater.name: Debater Detail Api
debater.description: Return a debater's public profile, standings history, and tournament results.

debaters.name: School Debaters Api
debaters.description:
API endpoint to list debaters from a specific school.

GET /api/debaters/<school_id>/
Returns: List of debaters active in the last 5 years for the specified school
Cached for 5 minutes per school.

team.name: Team Detail Api
team.description: Expose a team's roster, TOTY history, and tournament performances.

tournament.name: Tournament Detail Api
tournament.description: Provide tournament metadata, awards, speaker results, tab cards, and videos.

guide.name: Oty Guide Api
guide.description: Expose the OTY scoring explainer in a machine-readable format.

forum.name: Forum Profiles Api
forum.description: Resolve approved claims using the provider's immutable WordPress ID.

emails.name: Private Debater Emails Api
emails.description:
Return private debater contact emails for trusted mit-tab instances.

Auth is intentionally independent of browser sessions. Mittab-deploy injects a
bearer token into each ephemeral mit-tab instance, and black-rod keeps the
matching token in MITTAB_PRIVATE_API_TOKENS for manual rotation.
